note: The original description is Silvestri 1901 (a short notice in Tavola), whose full text could not be obtained on this machine; Emerson (1925) gave a complete redescription of the species, and all the content of this entry is taken from Emerson 1925. The text was extracted from the OCR of a library scan on Internet Archive.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; fontanelle slit-like, rather small; covered with short hairs and longer setae. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 equal to segment 4. Compound eyes medium-sized, not prominent, not very close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, separated from the compound eye by about their width or slightly more. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, the median line present but faint. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, the lateral margins rounded and forming with the posterior margin an almost even curve. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum deeply concave, almost always forming an angle slightly greater than a right angle. Wings dark smoky, the veins distinct. Abdominal tergites almost as dark as the head. Measurements: length with wings 8.50—9.00 mm; body length without wings 5.00—5.50 mm; head length 1.07—1.10 mm; head width 0.83—0.90 mm; antennal length 1.66 mm; compound eye diameter 0.25 mm; pronotum length 0.50 mm, width 0.71—0.80 mm; hind tibia length 1.13—1.17 mm; forewing length 6.56—7.26 mm, width 1.86—2.16 mm; queen body length 21 mm, abdominal width 4 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dull yellow, the sides straight and parallel, the anterior part slightly wider than the posterior, sparsely covered with long setae. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 slightly shorter. The notch of the labrum is shallower than in Mirotermes hispaniolae. Nasus rather short, not reaching the end of the labrum, but slightly more pointed than in M. hispaniolae. Pronotum pale, the anterior margin not concave. Legs pale. Abdominal tergites hairy, the hairs 1/3—1/2 as long as the marginal setae; the abdomen is the same colour as the gut contents. Measurements: head plus nasus length 1.35—1.70 mm; head width 0.77—1.00 mm; antennal length 2.23 mm; pronotum width 0.63 mm; hind tibia length 0.83—0.87 mm; left mandible length 1.67 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Closely related to M. hispaniolae, from which it differs in the smaller body, the more pointed nasus and the different abdominal pilosity. Type locality: Coxipó (Cuiabá), Brazil. New locality: Kartabo, British Guiana. Distribution: Paraguay, Brazil, British Guiana. Emerson notes that his identification is uncertain and that it agrees fairly well only with the mandibular tooth figures of Holmgren 1912 and with Silvestri's description. Emerson based the description on numerous alates, kings, queens and soldiers from 10 Kartabo colonies.
